description: Pre four-tyre-load baseline, predictable speed-only steering. Source snapshot in tmp/four_tyre_baseline; metrics are open-loop model fixtures, not lap time targets.

physics_cfg.aero.cfg:
; ICR2-inspired relative coefficients; absolute force scale is provisional.
; Scale maps internal coefficients to square metres. Density is applied once by physics.
; 0.8 / 46489 matches previous drag at speedway 10/10 degrees.
[meta]
schema_version=1
[aero]
air_density_kg_m3=1.225
body_package="speedway"
front_wing_deg=14.0
rear_wing_deg=8.0
coefficient_area_scale=0.00001720837187
physics_cfg.assists.cfg:
; Master multiplier; zero disables all assists. Independent strengths are 0..1.
[meta]
schema_version=1
[assists]
assistance_strength=1.0
; Speed-only steering range/rate help. Zero gives fixed physical lock at all speeds.
steering_assistance=1.0
stability_assistance=0.0
traction_control=0.0
anti_lock_brakes=1.0
steering_response_s=0.3
corner_grip_fraction=0.85
yaw_stability_rate_s=14.0
sideslip_damping_rate_s=10.0
traction_slip_limit=0.06
braking_slip_limit=0.12
physics_cfg.chassis.cfg:
; SI units. Initial tuning, not measured chassis specifications.
[meta]
schema_version=1
[chassis]
; Dry vehicle mass. Fuel is added at runtime from the player's selected load.
mass_kg=700.0
fuel_capacity_gal=35.0
fuel_density_kg_l=0.792
fuel_range_laps=60.0
fuel_reference_lap_m=1609.344
wheelbase_m=2.82
front_weight_fraction=0.43
cg_height_m=0.32
yaw_inertia_kgm2=1000.0
brake_force_n=18000.0
front_brake_bias=0.57
steering_lock_deg=28.0
high_speed_lock_deg=4.5
steering_reduction_speed_mps=75.0
steering_rate_deg_s=35.0
surface_step_m=0.15
physics_cfg.engine.cfg:
; User-supplied 1995 CART-inspired torque values. No claim of measured engine data.
; Each row is Vector3(RPM, closed-throttle torque Nm, full-throttle torque Nm).
[meta]
schema_version=1
[engine]
idle_rpm=2500.0
redline_rpm=13800.0
inertia_kgm2=0.18
throttle_rate_s=3.0
idle_control_gain=4.0
idle_control_max_nm=180.0
torque_curve=[Vector3(0,-10,30),Vector3(1000,-18,85),Vector3(2000,-26,150),Vector3(3000,-35,215),Vector3(4000,-45,260),Vector3(5000,-55,300),Vector3(6000,-68,340),Vector3(7000,-80,385),Vector3(8000,-92,430),Vector3(9000,-105,462),Vector3(10000,-118,472),Vector3(11000,-132,458),Vector3(12000,-146,435),Vector3(13000,-162,411),Vector3(13500,-170,392),Vector3(14000,-180,360)]
physics_cfg.gearbox.cfg:
[meta]
schema_version=1
[gearbox]
forward_ratios=[3.8,2.95,2.35,1.95,1.65,1.4]
reverse_ratio=3.5
final_drive=3.9
efficiency=0.94
shift_time_s=0.16
automatic_upshift_rpm=13000.0
automatic_downshift_rpm=7800.0
launch_rpm=4500.0
clutch_capacity_nm=650.0
clutch_stiffness_nm_s=30.0
clutch_engagement_rate_s=5.0
direction_change_max_mps=0.5
reverse_limit_kph=25.0
physics_cfg.tires.cfg:
; Two lumped axle tyres; stiffness is per axle, not per individual tyre.
[meta]
schema_version=1
[tires]
front_radius_m=0.315
rear_radius_m=0.34
front_cornering_stiffness_n_rad=90000.0
rear_cornering_stiffness_n_rad=110000.0
longitudinal_stiffness_n=90000.0
reference_load_n=3500.0
load_stiffness_exponent=0.85
friction_coefficient=1.65
; Sliding force relative to peak; falloff width in normalized combined demand.
sliding_grip_fraction=0.85
post_peak_falloff=2.0
grass_grip_multiplier=0.48
rolling_resistance=0.015
front_axle_inertia_kgm2=2.4
rear_axle_inertia_kgm2=3.2
slip_reference_speed_mps=3.0
physics_cfg.tyre_wear.cfg:
; Loaded when starting a session. Lower multipliers preserve tyres longer.
; Disable variation to give every car the baseline wear rate of 1.0.
[variation]
enabled=true
min_multiplier=0.85
max_multiplier=1.15
